integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium-wide locked-off shot frames a modern high-rise living room at night. A family of three sits side by side on a beige floral fabric sofa: on the left, a 40-year-old East Asian man in a black collared jacket over an off-white crew-neck sweater (S3, low quiet voice) sits in profile, silent; in the middle, a 30-year-old East Asian woman with long straight black hair, white pearl stud earrings, a wine-red satin slip dress with thin spaghetti straps and a thin silver chain with a slightly tarnished heart-shaped pendant (S2, warm gentle female voice) clasps her hands on her lap with a soft smile; on the right, an 8-year-old East Asian boy with short curly black hair in a navy blue hooded windbreaker over a white T-shirt (S1, bright clear child's voice) rises from the sofa cushion and turns toward his mother. Through the floor-to-ceiling windows behind them, a cool blue city skyline of lit skyscrapers glows; on the right side cabinet a large blue-and-white porcelain vase, a beige-shaded table lamp and a small potted plant are visible. Warm lamp light contrasts with the cool night outside.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the camera cuts to a medium over-the-shoulder shot from behind the father's left shoulder. The boy steps in front of his mother, leans down, and pinches the small heart pendant on her chest between his fingertips, frowning as he examines it closely. The mother tilts her head up and looks at him with a faint smile. The boy (S1) says: <d>[Chinese]妈，你这项链怎么都发黑了？</d>

[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the camera cuts to a tight close-up. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the mother's neck and collarbone; her red lips part in an amused smile. She (S2) says: <d>[Chinese]嗨，正常，假的，网上买的，三十九块九包邮。</d> The push-in settles on the thin silver chain and the slightly darkened heart pendant; the boy's fingertip enters from the lower right of frame.

[Shot 4] At 00:08.500, the camera cuts to a close-up over the mother's right shoulder. The boy frowns, pouts, and turns toward the father on the left side of frame, speaking with a resentful expression. He (S1) says: <d>[Chinese]爸，你也太小气了吧。我妈这么漂亮，你结婚就给她买假的？</d> The mother's profile is softly out of focus in the foreground, smiling.

[Shot 5] At 00:11.500, the camera cuts back to a medium-wide three-shot. The boy raises his right arm, extends his index finger toward the father, mouth open in protest. The father (S3) lowers his head helplessly and says: <d>[Chinese]臭小子。</d> The mother smiles and gently pats the boy's arm.

[Shot 6] At 00:14.000, the camera cuts to a medium close-up, focus on the mother. She turns her head to look softly at the father beside her, lips moving gently as she explains. The father sits in profile, silent; the boy behind his mother presses his lips together and listens quietly. The mother (S2) says: <d>[Chinese]这事还真不能怪你爸。</d>

[Shot 7] At 00:17.500, the camera cuts to a close profile shot of the mother gazing at the father, her eyes soft and wistful. She (S2) says: <d>[Chinese]当年他穷到为了娶我，差点把自己掏空。</d> The overall brightness gradually dims, the mood turns nostalgic, and two large golden calligraphic characters "多年前" fade in softly at the center of the frame, then hold and fade to black.

overall_soundscape: Quiet indoor living-room room tone throughout, with faint city night air coming through the closed windows. Sofa fabric rustles as the boy stands up, the small metal chain shifts softly when he pinches the pendant, and the table lamp emits a low warm hum.

non_diegetic_music: A sparse, warm solo piano at a slow tempo, joined by sustained low strings that gradually swell in volume toward the final nostalgic shot, then fade out.
